name: Livan
source:
The private artist who is working for aristocrat - Livan is polite and soft-spoken. A perfect gentleman if only he doesn't compare everything to paintings.

Livan is your most reliable ally and will readily lent you a hand whenever you are in need. He can be found in the Middle Ages.

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/area_x_cast_livan.html]official site[/url]]
